title: Export fails for large orders
complaint: The customer reports that exporting an order does nothing and no file arrives.

timeline.summary: Reported that the export does not work.
L1 told the customer they would check.

reproSteps: Open an order with more than 500 line items.
Observe that no file is produced.

rootCause.hypothesis: The export handler buffers every row before writing, so large orders exceed the request timeout.

evidence.finding: Timeouts after 30s on exports of large orders.

blastRadius: Any customer exporting an order above the row threshold.

proposedFix.description: Stream the export to the response instead of buffering it in memory.
proposedFix.risks: Streaming changes the error-handling path of the export endpoint.

openQuestions: Is the threshold a row count or a total payload size?
